caption: four powers, one couch - the 2005 movie tie-in where the co-op is the whole fantastic law.
about: Fantastic four (2005) ties into the first movie and builds everything around the team: four-player couch co-op where each member's power opens a different route, combo fusions between powers, and doctor doom as the closing act. As a movie tie-in it overachieved - the co-op design is a genuine 2005 highlight.
No windows build exists, so the platform is ps2 - played through pcsx2, rom sourced from romsfun.

req.note: at target - the ps2 build runs through pcsx2 within the haswell bar.
